name.description: kebab-case name for the recurring task, as a skill would be named.

task.description: One sentence: what the user keeps asking for.

session_ids.description: Ids from ===SESSIONS=== (s1, s2, …) whose work is this task. Only ids that appear in the input.

existing_skill.description: Exact name from ===INSTALLED_SKILLS=== whose description covers this task, else null.

steps.description: The repeatable procedure the sessions share, 2-6 short steps.

invoker_hints.description: Phrases the user actually typed to start this task, quoted from the prompts.

reason.description: One sentence naming the shared procedure that makes these sessions one task.
